harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-town-scum-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-21: zoo owner, "add experiment with town scumming" (a classes-18 pilot only; a small tier after the gate and the owner).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#594). Pilot (RULES 16) on classes-18, four arms,
18 starts each (72 games), all classes. The earlier zoo evidence (switches-early-2, C Borg and better-borg-c m4, 5,000 and
20,000 gold): 0 deaths, mean CL 1.00 to 1.16, because the character never left town; a survival without progress must
not be read as a lead.
Gate: no config_error (the legacy key borg_money_scum_amount must be read: check the applied value in the cell's
user/borg.txt and the resolved-settings receipt; if the build does not apply it, the arm is "not tested"); one binary;
every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart; frozen-turn bursts classified
(a Borg that stays in town for 100,000 turns is a turn_cap, not a stall: check the gold-unchanged rule).
Report per arm and class: whether the Borg ever left town and when (first game turn on DL1), purse at departure, turns in
town, townspeople killed and drops sold, thefts, the first-trip purchases (flasks, Cure Light Wounds, Phase Door, ranged),
deaths in town and in the dungeon with CL at death, final and maximum level, deepest level, identical plays; the Borg
needs a permanent light for the mode: count the starts that never meet it (the arm is then identical to ctl). Progress and
survival read together: an arm that stays in town is not a lead. Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 12c4ce7c, does staying in town killing townspeople until the purse reaches 500, 1,000 or 2,000 gold (borg_money_scum_amount) buy a safer first kit and an earlier start, or does it just keep the Borg in town (as 5,000 and 20,000 did on the C Borg: 0 deaths, CL 1.0)?
